campaigns.does_not_claim: The collector has not run live; the old build is not a current-build gate.
campaigns.fail_condition: A contradictory observation; an unmodelled diagnosis; an orphan body; a missing field treated as PASS.
campaigns.negative_control: A pre-fix host lacking a field is PRECONDITION; 'block 6 unknown', a JSON 'unaccepted'/'unfinalized' disposition, and an 'issue #6 accepted' line must not be a PASS; a later orphan must override an earlier accepted; a contradictory ready/reason pair must FAIL.
campaigns.observable: The phase-diagnosis table classification, the operator gate keys, the block-6 disposition, the height gap, and the readiness/fault/isolation consistencies.
campaigns.pass_condition: A read-only B/C/D GET /health and GET /api/v1/status/operator snapshot with the phase discriminator, block-6 disposition, height gap, fault latch and isolation, each PASS/FAIL/PRECONDITION.
campaigns.status_reason: Aria's 16 Nov read-only observation reaches four instances on two SSH hosts, but the installed build returns 404 for /api/v1/status/operator and the file logs are not a structured block-6 disposition. The collector must be run by the operator with a local plan.
campaigns.title: Private-chain surface: live B/C/D read-only phase diagnosis

campaigns.does_not_claim: A 1 GiB fault injection is a diagnosability probe, not supported-tier acceptance.
campaigns.fail_condition: An OOM/restart loop within the claimed supported tier, or one-host loss defeating the stated quorum fault model.
campaigns.negative_control: One-host loss must defeat the claimed quorum; a below-minimum 1 GiB injection is not supported-tier acceptance; a declared tier contradicted by a 24 GB replay must fail, and --allow-under-minimum is not a pass.
campaigns.observable: Measured per-validator RAM/CPU/peak RSS/replay headroom; stake per independent failure domain; the one-host-loss quorum calculation.
campaigns.pass_condition: Declare and measure per-validator minimum RAM/CPU, peak RSS, replay headroom, and a stake/failure-domain mapping on independently provisioned hosts; demonstrate the claimed host-failure tolerance.

related.criterion: the installed candidate pins are a prerequisite for measuring its tier

campaigns.status_reason: No declared supported tier or independently provisioned host/stake map. The resource-safety witness counts rnode processes only; it does not measure capacity or fault domains.
campaigns.title: Supported capacity and physical fault domains

campaigns.does_not_claim: A source-shape queue bound is not a pressure test.
campaigns.fail_condition: Silent accepted-write loss, unbounded work or queues, ambiguous acceptance, or uncontrolled memory pressure inside the accepted envelope.
campaigns.negative_control: Remove a queue bound and require the source-shape gate to fail; a load arm must show an explicit rejection, not a silent drop; the default configuration (in-flight limit unset) must not pass; a new refusal class outside the closed vocabulary must not be reported as 400.
campaigns.observable: Accepted/rejected counts and queue depth under HTTP/direct/gRPC load; a backpressure signal; no silent accepted-work loss.
campaigns.pass_condition: Verify independently, at HTTP, direct HTTP and gRPC: concurrent requests, memory/byte/term budgets, bounded queues, explicit backpressure, and deterministic acceptance/rejection.

related.criterion: bounded production is a prerequisite for the deploy-finalises witness

campaigns.status_reason: Source-shape queue bounds and the C105 backpressure work exist, and the criterion now evaluates a typed pressure record across HTTP, direct HTTP and gRPC; no installed-candidate pressure acceptance has run. The criterion refuses a local-devnet record for locality.
campaigns.title: Bounded public ingress and overload behavior

campaigns.does_not_claim: Instrument or send-log PASS is not state application.
campaigns.fail_condition: A claim based on a send log alone; an invalid observer address treated as a handler defect; a missing transport-delivery witness.
campaigns.negative_control: A loopback address advertised from another host must fail clearly; a send-log-only claim must not pass; the responder's stream completion must be observable, and a 'sent' log alone must fail.
campaigns.observable: The correlation request -> receipt -> response construction -> transport completion -> requester receive -> state application, with peer address and identity; the loopback negative control.
campaigns.pass_condition: An external observer advertises a routable peer address, authenticates and joins, receives and applies the approved fringe, and hydrates state. Negative control: 127.0.0.1 advertised from another host must fail clearly. Test alternative-peer failover separately.

campaigns.does_not_claim: A local partition drill or a green CI badge is not the N=4/N=8 release envelope.
campaigns.fail_condition: A permanent wedge within the declared fault model, inability to rejoin, or a safety-invariant violation.
campaigns.negative_control: Equal moving heads must not count as the criterion; a victim that never finalizes the fixed anchor must fail; a single-host bridge run below the supported tier must not pass.
campaigns.observable: A deploy finalizes; a fixed finalized anchor is retained by every validator on a K-sample dwell; partition/rejoin, host loss, restart/replay, and the approved root unchanged.
campaigns.pass_condition: Named, independently rerunnable N=4 and N=8 workloads under adequate independent-host capacity: deploy finalization, partition/rejoin, host loss, restart/replay, and safe recovery without changing the approved root.

related.criterion: G4 is the restart/recovery arm only, not the full N=4/N=8 envelope
